dependencies.$comment: Target-side bgfx: the renderer library only. The shader/texture/geometry compilers come from the host-side entry below so cross builds (riscv64-linux, arm64-windows, x64-osx on an arm64 runner) get tools that run on the build machine; when host and target triplets coincide vcpkg merges both entries into one bgfx[core,tools] install and nothing changes.
dependencies.name: bgfx
